name: Feature request / 기능 제안

title: "[Feature] "
---

<!-- Korean or English is welcome. -->

## Use case / 사용 목적

What are you trying to accomplish, and what is missing today?

## Proposed change / 제안 내용

Describe the smallest useful change and its expected behavior.

## Alternatives / 대안

Describe any existing workarounds or other approaches you considered.

## Scope and verification / 범위와 검증

How does this fit the roadmap? Which part of SAGA would own the behavior?
Describe how to verify it, including replay or regeneration behavior if relevant.
